{% raw %}
<p>This two-day course gives you a practical understanding of the ABS classification requirements that apply to submarine rescue systems, with a focus on rescue submersibles and the supporting systems required for safe design, construction, certification and continued service. You will learn how ABS requirements are applied across pressure hulls, viewports, piping, life support, electrical and control systems, hyperbaric facilities, handling systems, training fixtures, materials, welding and lifecycle surveys. Through technical instruction and real casualty case studies, the course connects design expectations, verification activities, and operational safeguards so participants can better evaluate compliance, identify risk and support safe rescue system performance.</p>
{% endraw %}
